entry.title: 基准测试显示，OpenAI的Jalapeño芯片专为大规模快速推理而设计
entry.summary: 在SemiAnalysis的InferenceX基准测试中，Jalapeño比当前最先进的芯片在每位用户令牌数和每千瓦吞吐量上均更优。 关键事实：Tested on SemiAnalysis’ InferenceX benchmark；Jalapeño registered both more tokens per user；more throughput per kilowatt than the currently available state-of-the art
